signature: SUBROUTINE ZLARGV( N, X, INCX, Y, INCY, C, INCC )

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of plane rotations to be generated.

params.name: x
params.reference: On entry, the vector x. On exit, x(i) is overwritten by r(i), for $i = 1$,...,n.

params.name: incx
params.reference: The increment between elements of X. $\mathrm{INCX} > 0$.

params.name: y
params.reference: On entry, the vector y. On exit, the sines of the plane rotations.

params.name: incy
params.reference: The increment between elements of Y. $\mathrm{INCY} > 0$.

params.name: c
params.reference: The cosines of the plane rotations.

params.name: incc
params.reference: The increment between elements of C. $\mathrm{INCC} > 0$.
